title: Towards Geographic Inclusion in the Evaluation of Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing generated images and real images across different regions (Africa, Europe, and Southeast Asia) by collecting over 65,000 human annotations from both in-region and out-of-region evaluators to assess geographic representation, similarity, and object consistency, and contrasting these with automated metrics like Region-CLIPScore.

Conducting a qualitative survey among cross-cultural annotators to analyze subjectivity and identify the use of cultural stereotypes (e.g., expectations of rudimentary infrastructure or traditional clothing) when judging the visual appeal and representativeness of text-to-image model outputs.
